newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Port Arthur gunman sentenced to life in jail.
newsitem.headline: Port Arthur gunman sentenced to life in jail.

text.p: An Australian court on Friday sentenced Port Arthur killer Martin Bryant to life in jail for the shooting massacre of 35 people in the southern island state of Tasmania in April.
Judge William Cox in the Tasmanian Supreme Court ordered that Bryant, 29, should be held in jail "for the term of his natural life".

Bryant confessed two weeks ago to unleashing modern Australia's worst mass murder among the ruins of a former penal colony at Port Arthur on April 28. He had earlier pleaded not guilty, insisting that he went surfing that day.
The court has heard this week that Bryant is a mentally disturbed man of severely limited intelligence who appeared to suffer a rare personality disorder called Asperger's Syndrome.
But Bryant is not criminally insane and knows right from wrong, according to psychiatric reports quoted to the court.
